column1: # Action-baseline rules.tsv supports IGNORE/WARN/FAIL. Security findings that
# must break the pipeline remain FAIL. Compatibility/behaviour findings below
# are explicitly documented and ignored only after review.

column3: (Public/dynamic route cache directives are application-controlled; API responses are separately required to be no-store)
(Next.js canonical trailing-slash redirects may omit Content-Type; these responses carry no application body or sensitive content)
(React escapes query-derived attribute values; auth continuation destinations are additionally constrained by safeDestination to local application routes)
(Server software version must not be exposed)
(Auth and protected-route 307 redirects are intentional and carry only local destination state; no credentials or sensitive payload are reflected)
(Dynamic Next.js responses may be intentionally non-storable)

(Next.js hydration currently requires inline bootstrap scripts; inline event-handler attributes are blocked with script-src-attr 'none', and third-party script origins are restricted to iyzico/iyzipay)
(COEP is not forced because hosted payment and external identity flows require cross-origin compatibility; COOP and CORP remain enabled)
